rule: Create places the character at a per-(race, class) row (map, zone, position, orientation) with start level and start money from config defaults. Starting kit is loaded from a playercreateinfo_item table (no current rows in tree) and stored into best free slots. Discovery XP: once per area (explored bit), scaled by the gap between character level and area level: far below uses the character's own level plus 5 as base; far above uses a percent that drops 5 per level past 5, clamped 0-100; otherwise full base. XP times Rate.XP.Explore. One packet to client carries area id and XP. Level-up uses a loop over XP thresholds and sends a level-up packet with stat gains. One-time client hints are 256 bits per account in eight 32-bit words, set one bit, clear-all or reset-all.

data_fields.name: start_location_row
data_fields.unit: (race, class) -> map, zone, x, y, z, orientation

look_test: 60-second phone walk through six fog zones; each first entry shows a two-second toast with the award. Three runs: flat award; donor curve; donor curve with the integer step fixed. Dom picks the run that makes him walk to the next zone and says whether the number is worth seeing.
